agents.name: Liora Thorne
habits: collects gossip like other people collect coins
reads at the cafe until closing
agents.bio: Liora Thorne is a 13-year-old resident of Kasukabe who attends the town school. Liora Thorne has grown up hearing about the mine collapse two valleys over as the thing that shaped the family before she was old enough to understand it, and has her own half-formed idea of what it meant. She lives at home with Corwin Thorne and Yara Thorne. She will do any dare going, and talks the smaller kids into worse ones than she'd try herself. She values not making fun of anyone's parents above almost anything, and fears, more than she lets on, losing a favorite thing forever. She collects gossip like other people collect coins.

agents.name: Halcyon Quarshie
habits: takes a walk through the park every dawn
argues politics with anyone who will listen
agents.bio: Halcyon Quarshie is a 11-year-old resident of Kasukabe who attends the town school. Halcyon Quarshie remembers, just barely, arriving in Kasukabe from a town on the far side of the forest 9 years ago, and still sometimes describes things as being different 'back home.' She lives at home with Milo Quarshie and Greta Quarshie. She will wait her turn longer than any other kid on the street, and rarely says so when she's tired of waiting. She values keeping a friend's secret above almost anything, and fears, more than she lets on, being laughed at in front of the whole class. She takes a walk through the park every dawn.
